Retorio is an AI coaching platform for enterprise sales, service, and leadership teams. Founded at the Technical University of Munich eight years ago, it was built on research developed at TUM, MIT, and the University of Tokyo, making it one of the few platforms in this space with genuine scientific foundations rather than marketing claims.

The core idea is straightforward. The more powerful AI becomes, the more buyers seek real human connection. Customers do not buy from the most technically proficient rep in the room. They buy from the person they trust. Retorio exists to develop that quality at scale, turning transactional sellers into trusted advisors through repeated, realistic practice and precise behavioral feedback.

What is AI sales training for manufacturing teams?
AI sales training for manufacturing is practice-based coaching in which sales engineers, field reps and distributor partners rehearse real industrial buying conversations with AI buyers.

A rep talks to an AI plant manager or procurement lead by video or phone, then sees where they listed features instead of linking them to uptime, lifecycle cost and total cost of ownership. They repeat until the value story holds.
Which industrial sales conversations can reps practice?

Reps practice the conversations that decide industrial orders: discovery with plant managers and engineers, procurement negotiations against a cheaper quote, buying committee presentations, CFO questions on ROI, and service upsell for spare parts, retrofits and service contracts.
